effects.1: Regrow all missing hair. If you aren't missing any, your hair grows 1 foot longer instantly.
effects.2: For the next minute, you can only speak in rhyme and song.
effects.3: A confused, non-hostile Flumph appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you and vanishes after 1 minute.
effects.4: You cast Fireball as a 3rd-level spell centered on yourself.
effects.5: Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. A Remove Curse spell ends this effect.
effects.6: An eye grows on your forehead for the next hour. You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
effects.7: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
effects.8: You transport to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, after which you return to the space you previously occupied.
effects.9: Maximize the damage of the next damaging spell you cast within the next minute.
effects.10: Your age changes by a factor of 1d10 years. Odd rolls make you younger, even rolls make you older.
effects.11: A flock of 1d6 harmless spectral chickens manifests around you for 10 minutes, clucking loudly.
effects.12: You gain the ability to breathe underwater for the next 24 hours.
effects.13: A single gold piece in your pocket transforms into a highly aggressive, normal-sized beetle.
effects.14: For the next hour, you emit a faint, beautiful glow of moonlight in a 15-foot radius.
effects.15: Your voice becomes incredibly deep and echoing for the next 24 hours.
effects.16: You accidentally cast Levitate on yourself, drifting 10 feet into the air for 1 minute.
effects.17: Illusionary butterflies float around you in a 5-foot radius for the next 10 minutes.
effects.18: You take 1d10 necrotic damage, and your hair turns completely snow-white.
effects.19: For the next minute, any object you touch that isn't being worn or carried ignites into harmless, green flames.
effects.20: You instantly regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.
effects.50: A massive, heavy iron anvil falls from the sky, crashing into an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
effects.75: All gold pieces you are carrying are temporarily turned into wooden buttons for 1 hour.
effects.100: You regain all expended spell slots, and a gentle chime echoes out to a distance of 300 feet.
